title: Tijaabadii Dhagaxa Baxsan
intro: Bulsho, xirfad leh oo kibir badan, ayaa dhaxalkoodii ku xardhay buuraha. Laakiin markii calaamad cad loo soo diray, imtixaan iimaan iyo is-xakamayn ah, kibirkoodii wuxuu ku horseeday waddo aan dib loo soo celin karin. Ma aqoonsan kartaa kooxdan iyo natiijada ka dhalatay caasinimadooda?
clues: Waxaan ahayn xirfadlayaal dhagax ah, annagoo si toos ah u xardhaynay guryo qurux badan oo ku yaal buuraha.
Rasuul ka mid ah dadkeenna ayaa noo yimid, isagoo noogu yeeraya inaan caabudno Ilaaha runta ah ee keliya.
Waxaan dalbanay calaamad muujinaysa hadalladiisa, waxaana la soo saaray makhluuqaad gaar ah oo imtixaan noo ah.
Waxaa naloo siiyay amar fudud: inaan la wadaagno isha biyaha noolaheenna makhluuqan, annagoo u oggolaanayna inuu cabbo maalintii loo qoondeeyay.
Kibirkeenna awgiis, dhowr naga mid ah ayaa shirqoolay oo waan ka hor imaannay digniinta, annagoo ku dhufanayna makhluuqaadka loogu talagalay inuu calaamad noo noqdo.
Saddex maalmood ka hor intaanan dhiman waxaa naloo dhiibay, ka dibna qarax xooggan ayaa na qabsaday guryaheenna, naga dhigay kuwo aan noolayn oo rogmaday.

arabic: فَعَقَرُوا۟ ٱلنَّاقَةَ وَعَتَوْا۟ عَنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّهِمْ وَقَالُوا۟ يَـٰصَـٰلِحُ ٱئْتِنَا بِمَا تَعِدُنَآ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
verse: So they hamstrung the she-camel and were insolent toward the command of their Lord and said, "O Ṣāliḥ, bring us what you promise us, if you should be of the messengers." (7:77)
